user_id: Learner business key. Use it to count distinct people across SCD versions.
history_id: Source history version key; one learner can have several versions.
full_name: Synthetic Faker name; surrounding whitespace is trimmed in Silver.
email: Synthetic example.invalid address; Silver trims and lowercases it.
city: City at the applicable history version; see user_history and dim_user.
country: Country code; the generator uses VN. Silver uppercases the value.
created_at: UTC creation time; generated learners start in 2022.
valid_from: Inclusive start of the SCD2 effective interval, in UTC.
valid_to: Exclusive end of the SCD2 interval; 2100-01-01 denotes the current version.
is_current: 1 for the current history version, otherwise 0.
title: Course, lesson or quiz title, depending on the table.
category: Course category: Data, Programming, Business, Design or Language.
price_vnd: Current course list price, nonnegative integer VND; not historical payment revenue.
lesson_id: Lesson business key; the generator creates ten lessons per course.
position: Lesson order inside its course, 1 through 10 in the generator.
quiz_id: Quiz business key; the generator creates one quiz per course.
total_questions: Number of questions; generated quizzes and attempts contain 20.
enrollment_id: Enrollment business key; retained as a reference on activity facts.
enrolled_at: UTC enrollment time; learner history is selected at this instant.
completed_at: UTC completion; nullable for incomplete enrollments, required for lesson completions.
lessons_completed: Current enrollment progress; not a daily historical progress series.
payment_id: Payment business key; the generator creates one payment per enrollment.
transaction_id: Unique transaction reference retained on the payment fact.
paid_at: UTC payment time; generated as enrollment time plus 60 seconds.
original_vnd: Original amount recorded on the transaction, integer VND.
discount_vnd: Discount in integer VND, between zero and the original amount.
charged_vnd: Charged amount before refunds: original_vnd minus discount_vnd.
refunded: Full-refund flag, 0 or 1. No separate refund event timestamp exists.
net_vnd: Retained revenue: charged_vnd times (1-refunded), on the original payment date.
completion_id: Lesson completion event key; enrollment and lesson identify one completion.
time_spent_seconds: Positive time spent on a lesson completion or quiz attempt, in seconds.
attempt_number: Attempt sequence within an enrollment and quiz.
correct_count: Correct answers, from zero through total_questions.
is_passed: 1 when correct answers divided by questions is at least 70 percent.
is_completed: 1 when the enrollment has completed_at; completion-rate numerator.
date_sk: Calendar key YYYYMMDD; zero is the unknown date row.
enrolled_date_sk: Enrollment-date role of dim_date, derived from enrolled_at.
completed_date_sk: Completion-date role of dim_date; zero for incomplete enrollments.
full_date: Calendar day. 1970-01-01 is used only for the unknown row.
year: Calendar year; zero for the unknown date.
quarter: Quarter 1 through 4; zero for the unknown date.
month: Calendar month in dim_date; YYYYMM in the monthly revenue aggregate.
day: Day of month; zero for the unknown date.
user_sk: SCD2 version surrogate key: history_id plus 10000000.
method_sk: Payment method surrogate key: method_id plus 5000000.
updated_at: UTC source-version timestamp, updated by the source trigger.
dw_revision: Monotonic source revision; zero identifies the baseline seed or migrated data.
revision: Per-change revision used to reject stale replay.
source_xid: Full transaction ID of the source transaction recorded in the journal.
source_id: Business key of the source row.
table_name: Source table name from the warehouse contract.
operation: INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE or a durable staged-delta operation.
raw_payload: Original JSON payload retained for replay or investigation.
changed_at: UTC time at which the source trigger recorded the change.
source_updated_at: Source updated_at value of the rejected version.
error_code: Machine-readable schema, domain or reference error code.
rejection_reason: Human-readable explanation of the rejected change.
detected_at: UTC time at which staging detected the invalid change.
resolved_at: UTC resolution time; NULL while the rejection remains unresolved.
last_processed_time: Informational timestamp, not the authoritative journal checkpoint.
last_processed_id: Business key accompanying the informational timestamp.
last_run_id: Publication run that confirmed the informational watermark.
phase: extracting, building, publishing, completed, failed or recovered.
manifest: Run metadata with counts, fingerprints, checks and measurements.
publication: Durable per-table old/new UUID plan used for recovery.
safe_xid: Source transaction checkpoint for the next journal read.
published_at: UTC time authoritative publication state was committed.
needs_full: A committed full stage still requires a complete Gold rebuild.
gmv: Sum of original amounts before discounts and refunds, in VND.
refund_vnd: Sum of fully refunded charged amounts, in VND.
payments: Number of payment transactions in the aggregate group.
refunds: Number of fully refunded transactions in the aggregate group.
enrollments: Number of enrollments in the aggregate group.
completions: Number of enrollments with completed_at in the group.
completion_days: Sum of completed enrollment durations, in days.
